exposure: Novel method in stage 1 surgery for hypoplastic left heart syndrome (HLHS) and its variants
cohort: 16 consecutive patients diagnosed with hypoplastic left heart syndrome or its variants who underwent a novel surgical method between February 2019 and March 2021.
finding: The novel method for stage 1 surgery in hypoplastic left heart syndrome and its variants shows potential as an effective alternative, despite a number of early postoperative deaths.
followup_time: Short-term (including early postoperative period and time waiting for stage 2 surgery)
